Title: Kindred segregation, Couriers and War Ghouls

Messages.Author: legb...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Kindred Segregation [Jyhad, V:TES]
Cardtype: Political Action
Political Card-Worth 1 Vote. Called by any vampire at +1 stealth.
Successful <referendum> means that all allies are burned.
Any Methuselah can keep an ally or allies he or she controls by
repaying <their cost to recruit>.

If someone calls a KS, must Tzimisce players who want to keep their War
ghouls pay 3 pool and a retainer? i guess not, because the retainer isn't
really part of the cost - s/he gets burnt when the War Ghoul enters play.

How about Couriers? Must somebody burn 2 blood to keep one of the little
bike-riding fellows?

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 13 Nov 2000 legb...@my-deja.com wrote:
> Political Card-Worth 1 Vote. Called by any vampire at +1 stealth.
> Successful <referendum> means that all allies are burned.
> Any Methuselah can keep an ally or allies he or she controls by
> repaying <their cost to recruit>.
>
> If someone calls a KS, must Tzimisce players who want to keep their War
> ghouls pay 3 pool and a retainer? i guess not, because the retainer isn't
> really part of the cost - s/he gets burnt when the War Ghoul enters play.

Indeed.

> How about Couriers? Must somebody burn 2 blood to keep one of the little
> bike-riding fellows?

Tricky one.

Methuselahs don't play blood costs, which is what KS wants. There would
be an argument for:

1) Not paying blood, and keep the ally
2) Not paying blood and, since you haven't, burn the ally
3) Paying blood from someone and keep the ally
or
4) Don't pay blood from someone and burn the ally

Eep. I lean towards either:

1) Since Methuselahs can't play blood costs, you keep the ally in this
case or
3) Pay the blood from someone and keep the ally

I would be disheartened were a ruling such as 2) to be given (which is
supportable by card text, I think), since it dis-empowers the ally. And
we want allies to be better.

Indeed. I'd say that, for both these case (and all others), Kindred Segregation
only requires that the pool cost be paid in order to keep the ally.
In the case of War Ghoul, that's 3 pool. In the case of Courier, that's 0 pool.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
legb...@my-deja.com wrote:
> And say you have Regina Giovanni or the Little Tailor [suits you, sir!]
> of Prague in play. Now there is not "the" cost of the ally, but two
> alternative costs. Can you choose to pay the cheaper one?

The cost is only "continuously reduced" while the card in question is on
the vampire in question. So, for allies, the full cost to recruit is paid
when Kindred Segregation passes in order to keep the ally.
